in_marathi.name: Haimavati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the cold mountain river
in_marathi.long_meaning: Haimavati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She is the goddess of the cold mountain river, known as the personification of the goddess Ganga in her mountain form. She is also believed to be the wife of Lord Shiva.
